records.groupTitle: Employment Rate Of Residents With Disabilities By Age
records.title: Employment Rate Of Residents With Disabilities By Age, Annual
records.footnote: Data for persons with disabilities aged 15 - 64 years pertain to the resident population (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) and are based on two-year moving average of employment rates in June of reference years to smoothen out year-on-year fluctuations due to the relatively small number of persons with disabilities. For example, 2019 figure refers to the average of June 2018 and June 2019.
